product_metadata.title: ALLZONE Shower Caddy Corner Organizer for Bathroom,Bathtub Shampoo Storage Holder Rack with Rustproof Stainless Tension Pole,4-Tier Adjustable Shelves,Stand on Floor,56-114 Inches Height,Brown
features: 📚【Rustproof Stainless Pole】- Allzone shower caddy corner is constructed by 4 premium SUS 304 stainless rods which can effectively prevent from rusting. Plus 4 solid plastic never-rust shelves. It can be installed in bathroom, shower room, college dorm, toilet for more than 3 years.

📋【4 Large Shelves Organizer】- Each shelf can storage 2 large 32 oz pump bottles or 4 16oz bottles. Ideal for contain bath supplies like shampoo, soap, conditioner, body wash, towel bar, hook razor, sponge and more. The shelf has a self-draining system, so it will not accumulate water and will keep your bath products clean and tidy.

🛀【 Fit Most Showers-Not for drop or slope ceiling】- The package comes with 4 poles for you to adjust the height, no need to bother you to cut the rod, you can place this shower caddy on any height as described within 56-114 inch. With this shower shelf organizer, you always have all of your bathroom accessories right within easy reach when you're in the shower in any bathroom!

⚽ 【 More Solid Than You Think】- With 4 durable shelves, no need to worry it will break.Compare others’ flimsy shelves, our caddy is thicker and deeper, bottles will not fall off the tray. It can keep all your shower essentials in one shower caddy. Thanks to the plastic shelf, It is much easier to clean than metal baskets.

🚕【 ASSEMBLY & 100% SATISFACTION 】- Our shower caddy comes with labeled pieces for you to distinguish parts and It takes you around 20 minutes to assemble. Each accessories are sealed with separated bags to prevent from scratch. ALLZONE is committed to providing excellent products and 100% satisfactory pre-sale and after-sale services. You have 1 YEAR UP.
